1981-2415-7272-7918.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7272-7918.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature

Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.

1385-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1984-4691-4971.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing yourself from losing the game this turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Angel's Grace.

728-3055-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

Cast that creature by paying {0}.

When Accursed Centaur dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Accursed Centaur that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Accursed Centaur token instead.

Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.

Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.

Repeat.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.

Have Sakashima's Student enter the battlefield as a copy of Medomai the Ageless and deal combat damage, gaining you an extra turn.
